title: A number in many forms
description:
Read one whole number n from 0 to 65535 and describe it with arithmetic and bit instructions. For `2024`:

```
n = 2024
n * n = 4096576
n / 7 = 289 remainder 1
n * 10 (lea and add) = 20240
n / 16 (a shift) = 126
low byte = 232
high byte = 7
hex: 0x7e8
binary: 0000011111101000
odd? 0
bits 4 to 7 = 14
-n = -2024
-n shifted right 2 (sar) = -506
```

| Line | Worked out with |
|---|---|
| `n * n` | `imul` |
| `n / 7 = Q remainder R` | `div` (unsigned) |
| `n * 10` | `lea` and `add`, no multiply |
| `n / 16` | `shr` |
| `low byte`, `high byte` | `and`, and `shr` with `and` |
| `binary` | `print_bin` with 16 bits |
| `odd?` | `and` with 1 |
| `bits 4 to 7` | a shift and a mask |
| `-n`, then `sar` by 2 | `neg` and `sar` |

All the numbers are printed with the routines; the text is zero-terminated strings.

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
s_n:    db      "n = ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        call    read_int
        mov     rbx, rax
        lea     rdi, [rel s_n]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

solution.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
s_n:     db     "n = ", 0
s_sq:    db     "n * n = ", 0
s_div:   db     "n / 7 = ", 0
s_rem:   db     " remainder ", 0
s_ten:   db     "n * 10 (lea and add) = ", 0
s_16:    db     "n / 16 (a shift) = ", 0
s_low:   db     "low byte = ", 0
s_high:  db     "high byte = ", 0
s_hex:   db     "hex: ", 0
s_bin:   db     "binary: ", 0
s_odd:   db     "odd? ", 0
s_bits:  db     "bits 4 to 7 = ", 0
s_neg:   db     "-n = ", 0
s_sar:   db     "-n shifted right 2 (sar) = ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        call    read_int
        mov     rbx, rax                ; n stays in rbx

        lea     rdi, [rel s_n]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_sq]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        imul    rdi, rbx                ; n * n
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        mov     rax, rbx                ; n / 7 and n % 7, unsigned
        xor     edx, edx
        mov     ecx, 7
        div     rcx
        mov     r12, rax
        mov     r13, rdx
        lea     rdi, [rel s_div]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel s_rem]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r13
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_ten]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rbx + rbx*4]      ; n * 5
        add     rdi, rdi                ; n * 10
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_16]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        shr     rdi, 4                  ; n / 16
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_low]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        and     edi, 0xFF               ; the low byte
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_high]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        shr     edi, 8
        and     edi, 0xFF               ; the byte above it
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_hex]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        call    print_hex
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_bin]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        mov     esi, 16
        call    print_bin
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_odd]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        and     edi, 1                  ; 1 when odd
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_bits]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        shr     edi, 4
        and     edi, 0x0F               ; bits 4 to 7
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_neg]
        call    print_str
        mov     r12, rbx
        neg     r12                     ; -n
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel s_sar]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r12
        sar     rdi, 2                  ; -n / 4, rounding down
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

requirements: Keep n in a register the routines leave alone.
Use no jumps or loops: only straight-line code.
Write a comment beside each calculation saying what it computes.
rules: Multiply by 10 with lea and add.
